description: The production deployment on Baseten's Model APIs: a live model profile must serve (the offline scripted model refuses under this name), the store is Postgres via DATABASE_URL, and the serving profile's key must be present in the environment. Dual control is required: review acceptance and model promotion (including rollback) each complete only on two recorded decisions by different actors, neither of them the actor who created the object being decided. Naming this profile binds these rules — a configuration that violates one refuses at startup, by name, before anything serves.
label: Hosted — Baseten Model APIs, the production shape
name: hosted
